info.name: Client Management — Client API QA
info.description:
Full QA test suite for the Client Management API.

Base URL: http://localhost:8080/clients

Actual endpoints:
  POST   /clients/add
  GET    /clients/all
  DELETE /clients/delete/{id}
  GET    /clients/{id}       — NOT IMPLEMENTED
  PUT    /clients/{id}       — NOT IMPLEMENTED

Converted from pytest suites:
  • test_01_crud.py        — Core CRUD lifecycle
  • test_02_edge_cases.py  — Boundary & validation tests
  • test_03_integrity.py   — Cascade delete, manager linkage, missing fields, URL conventions, security

Run all folders IN ORDER with the Postman Collection Runner.
Ensure the Spring Boot backend is running before executing.
